title: Quantification of ARF-GTP in HepG2 by pulldown with GST-GGA3\(1-316)
protocol: Seed 10^7 cells into five 120 mm cell culture dishes.
Incubate overnight at 37°C, 5% CO₂ in full medium (EMEM/10% FCS).
Wash cells twice with PBS and exchange the medium for EMEM without FCS.
Grow cells overnight under the same conditions.
Add inhibitors to dishes: dishes 1 and 2 receive 0.2% DMSO; dish 3 receives SecinH3 at 12.5 μM; dish 4 receives SecinH3 at 6.25 μM; dish 5 receives D5 at 25 μM.
Incubate dishes with inhibitors for 3 hours at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Stimulate cells with 100 nM insulin for 10 minutes at 37°C.
Wash cells twice with ice-cold PBS.
Harvest cells with a rubber policeman in 1.5 mL lysis buffer.
Incubate the cell lysates on ice for 20 minutes.
Sonicate samples for 7 seconds, 40% intensity, cycle 50.
Centrifuge the mixture at maximum speed for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Collect 1200 μL of supernatant and incubate with GST-GGA3 beads (50 μg GST-GGA3 per tube) for 2 hours at 4°C under mild agitation.
Centrifuge samples for 1 minute at 500 x g, discard the supernatant.
Wash pellets three times with lysis buffer.
Add 50 μL Laemmli loading buffer to each pellet and incubate at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Separate proteins by 15% SDS-PAGE; normalize protein loading based on cell lysates' protein content.
Transfer proteins onto nitrocellulose using a semi-dry blotting method.
Block the nitrocellulose membrane with 5% milk powder in TBS/0.1% Tween-20 for 20 minutes.
Wash the nitrocellulose twice with TBST.
Dilute anti-ARF6-antibody to a 1:100 dilution in 5% BSA/TBST.
Incubate the diluted antibody overnight at 4°C.
Wash nitrocellulose three times with TBST.
Dilute goat-anti-mouse-HRP conjugate to a 1:20,000 dilution in 5% milk powder/TBST.
Incubate the HRP conjugate for one hour at room temperature.
Wash nitrocellulose with TBST.
Cover nitrocellulose with ECL solution and incubate for three minutes at room temperature.
Visualize luminescence using VersaDoc 5000 (BioRad).
